privateMempoolDashboardImport.excludedReason: OpenBitcoin monthly block-count shares remain separate from the Mempool weekly estimated-hashrate series; only the distinct weekly metric IDs are included.

openBitcoinUtxoFlowImport.formula: utxo_created_count(t) = utxo_count_eod(t) - utxo_count_eod(t-1) + utxo_spent_count(t). On dates without an end-of-day block observation, carry forward only the prior UTXO state; OBM spent count must be zero on those dates. Counts include spendable outputs and exclude provably unspendable outputs under OBM definitions.

bitviewHodlAgePercentageImport.source: Private Bitview UTXO age cohorts plus Bitcoin daily supply
bitviewHodlAgePercentageImport.licenseNote: Private local research only. No separate reuse license for hosted Bitview data was identified; public redistribution and public dashboard display are not cleared.
bitviewHodlAgePercentageImport.formula: For each UTC day and age threshold: 100 * Bitview spendable UTXO supply above the age threshold / Bitcoin total supply. Exact Bitview cohort methodology is provisional; input series and dates are retained without interpolation.

byKaranteliBitcoinPerpVolume.methodology: For each UTC date, sum the source-reported rolling 24-hour USD volumes only for symbol=BTC, market=perp, across the fixed intersection of venue/quote feeds that have a non-missing observation on all 21 dates. Values are daily snapshots of rolling 24-hour volume, not disjoint calendar-day totals. Spot rows and other symbols are excluded.

metric.numeratorDescription: Number of transactions containing at least one output of a BRK locking-script type. Each transaction is counted once per type; the `all` aggregate counts every transaction, including coinbase. Uses pay-to-Taproot outputs. Total of the per-block values over the trailing window ending at the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Uses a trailing 24-hour window.
metric.denominatorDescription: Number of transactions, including the coinbase transaction. Total of the per-block values over the trailing window ending at the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Uses a trailing 24-hour window.

scope.emptyBitcoinMetricScope: Catalog metrics with no observations, excluding standalone macro-only metrics; Bitcoin comparison metrics remain in scope. Recalculated from the current master and catalog.

binanceFundingDailyMean.source: Binance USDⓈ-M Futures public REST API
binanceFundingDailyMean.eventAggregation: Arithmetic mean of regular BTCUSDT settlement funding rates within each UTC calendar day, multiplied by 100 to percent; no rescaling to an 8-hour interval and no interpolation.
binanceFundingDailyMean.sourceMethodBoundary: The ByKaranteli BTCUSDT daily snapshot remains as bykaranteli_daily_snapshot; Binance settlement means are the main series. Only 4 of 49 overlapping dates round to the same value at the imported precision.

qualityNotes: Master keys were checked for duplicates during each merge.
The UWA options activity candidate passed the existing observation checker with no duplicate keys and native-period gap handling.
Five snapshot-only metric IDs have no observations because their only snapshot was dated 2026-09-29.
The September 29 mining-pool and fee snapshot was excluded to honor the cutoff.
Coin Metrics Community API requests used assets=btc only. Six new daily Coin Metrics series have continuous coverage and end at the inclusive 2026-09-28 cutoff.
The three USD exchange series each contain 5,637 consecutive daily BTC observations from 2011-04-24 through 2026-09-28, combining the Coin Metrics BTC archive and the Community API.
No new non-Bitcoin or macro observations were added. The existing ECB rows remain only as the BTC/EUR conversion reference.
The single new 2026-09-28 BTC price key from the preceding update was absent before that merge.

Added 133,882 provisional Bitcoin-only Bitview research values for private local use. Excluded 1,406 zero Realized Price placeholders; left the five no-block genesis dates absent. Public redistribution and public dashboard display are not cleared.

2026-09-29 refresh added 12 Coin Metrics BTC observations, 6 Open Bitcoin Metrics observations, and 40 new private Bitview observations through the 2026-09-28 cutoff; 20 Bitview values were revised and 20 rows dated September 29 were excluded.

The master before OpenBitcoin and Mempool research additions had 687,533 rows and SHA-256 c2de633c922f8a45b74fdb0d958a7bfa69d70569d8483be3d5d59e6959525fe1. The general observer checker was not rerun after those additions; each merge rejected duplicate metric/series/date keys.

Mempool.space Lightning history has 3,639 Bitcoin observations across seven metric IDs, from 2023-09-30 through 2026-08-30. Those rows now appear in the local master for private research only; the documentation does not identify a separate data reuse license and public use is not cleared.
Bitcoin Lab retrieval is deferred until the user sets BITLAB_API_TOKEN locally.
The Coin Metrics Community catalog was rechecked with assets=btc and listed 31 BTC fields; the 20 fields mapped by the dashboard importer add no previously empty dashboard metric.

Mempool.space Bitcoin-only candidates originally contained 8,201 rows across eleven IDs. 5,831 Lightning and fee p10/p90 rows were merged into the local master for private research; 2,370 weekly hashrate pool-share and HHI rows remain outside because the active pool series uses monthly directly counted blocks. Public redistribution is not cleared.
The Mempool mining-pool candidate derives concentration from weekly hashrate shares, not direct pool block counts; it remains explicitly a proxy and is not in the active master.

The active master contains 737,119 observations from 143 Bitcoin metric IDs through 2026-09-28. Three provisional Bitcoin supply-age percentages add 19,416 private Bitview-derived observations from 2009-01-09 through 2026-09-28. Public redistribution is not cleared. No upload was performed.

One provisional private Bitcoin Lightning observation was derived for 2026-08-30: total public channel capacity divided by same-time public node count. It is one snapshot only; no gaps were filled and public redistribution is not cleared. The master was not uploaded.

Merged 1308 provisional Bitcoin-only ETF observations from ByKaranteli CC0 data for 2025-05-20 through 2026-09-08. Four metric fields were mapped directly from the BTC rows; non-Bitcoin rows, unreported dates, and dates after the source coverage end were not added. No upload was performed.

Added 50 provisional Bitcoin dominance observations from the source daily-market file for 2026-07-23 through 2026-09-10. Only the date and BTC dominance field were kept; no other source columns or observations were imported. The data remained local.

Added 126 provisional Bitcoin-only BTCUSDT liquidation observations from ByKaranteli CC0 data for 2026-07-30 through 2026-09-09. Daily values sum reported long and short liquidations across the venue rows available on each day; coverage varies and the source describes the recorded events as a floor. Non-Bitcoin symbols were excluded. The data remained local.

Added one provisional Bitcoin-only options open-interest snapshot from ByKaranteli CC0 data for 2026-08-30. The USD notional multiplies Deribit BTC open interest by the source-row underlying USD price for each of 1,026 reported BTC option instruments. ETH instruments were excluded. It is a single Deribit snapshot, not an all-exchange historical series. The data remained local.

Added 36 provisional Bitcoin-only current-quarter futures basis observations from ByKaranteli CC0 data for 2026-08-06 through 2026-09-10. The source annualized_pct field is used directly for the BTC contract with expiry 2026-09-25. ETH and the next_quarter BTC tenor were excluded. No dates were interpolated; the data remained local.

Added 49 BTCUSDT-only Binance USDT-M funding values and 49 24-hour open-interest percentage changes from the ByKaranteli CC0 daily-symbols snapshot. The snapshot ends 2026-09-10, omits 2026-07-26, and 11 of 48 adjacent open-interest values repeat; both metrics remain provisional and local.

Added 37 daily BTC-only options-flow observations for five direct provider fields from the ByKaranteli CC0 Deribit + OKX archive. The pinned file ends 2026-09-10. Field formulas, put-share denominator and block threshold are not fully documented; no field was converted into options_put_call_ratio. Values remain provisional and local.

Added 35 provisional BTC-only Deribit options open-interest observations from pinned ByKaranteli CC0 daily revisions, 2026-08-06 through 2026-09-10. The existing 2026-08-30 value was independently matched to the pinned commit. The source history has 36 consecutive daily snapshots; only BTC rows were summarized and imported. No ETH rows were written. This is one-exchange open interest, not a global options-market total.

2026-09-30: added 193 private monthly BTC/Gold ratio observations using Coin Metrics BTC PriceUSD and World Bank Pink Sheet gold monthly averages; the gold series is used only as a denominator and no standalone gold metric was imported.

2026-09-30: added 17 private exact-common-date US spot ETF holdings sums for five products only; this is not total US spot ETF holdings, missing dates were not filled, and public redistribution was not cleared.

Added 2576 daily Binance BTCUSDT settlement-rate means (7727 payments) from 2019-09-10 through 2026-09-28. Kept 49 overlapping ByKaranteli snapshots as series bykaranteli_daily_snapshot; only 4 overlap values match at imported precision. Binance data remain local provisional research; public redistribution rights are not cleared.
